assembled.summary: Recent coverage highlights how speedcubing is expanding into fast-paced, spectator-friendly formats. A July 17, 2026 RTL Today report describes a European twist on competition—using a brief inspection window and sensor timing to begin solves—showing the sport’s emphasis on precision under pressure.

stories.headline: Europe’s speedcubing twist adds 15-second inspection and sensor timing
bullets: RTL Today reports competitors get only 15 seconds to examine a freshly scrambled cube before starting their solve.
Timing begins via a sensor when hands touch the cube, with results measured to the hundredth of a second.
The format aims to add tension and immediacy while keeping core speedcubing measurement front and center.
